Entries.Text: The shoebox layout of the selected sheet: the named cells the game's menus cut icons and images from.
Select a texture to see its layout.
The layout file that describes this sheet. Layouts are paired with the TPF in their own folder (menu/hi/01_common.sblytbnd with menu/hi/01_common.tpf).
There is no layout binder paired with this TPF to add one to.
Add an empty layout for this sheet to the paired layout binder, formatted like the binder's other layouts. Add cells to it with Add Next Slot, Draw Mode or the grid generator.
{0} (Smithbox's bundled layout; saving writes your copy to the project's Icon Layouts folder)
Unsaved changes: Save writes the layout to the project.
Read-only: the file couldn't be read losslessly ({0}).
Read-only: this layout is generated by Smithbox.
What the viewport draws over the sheet.
Outline every cell. The hovered and selected cells are always outlined. Half-resolution cells use their own color.
Write each cell's name in it, where it fits.

Click a cell to select it (Shift adds), drag to move, drag a corner to resize, arrow keys nudge (Shift: 10 px), Delete removes, Escape clears. Cells with the same rectangle (aliases) are selected and moved together.
Drag on the sheet to draw a new cell. It is named after the selected (or last) cell with the next free number.
Moves, resizes and drawn cells snap to multiples of this many pixels. 1 = every pixel.
The first selected cell. Rectangle changes apply to every selected cell; the name only to this one.
Click a cell in the viewport or the list to see it.
Click a cell in the viewport or the list to edit it.
The cell's name. Icon cells are found by their number (MENU_ItemIcon_00123.png is icon 123), so renaming one changes which icon it is.
In sheet pixels. Applied to every selected cell when the field loses focus.
The cell is stored at half resolution and drawn at twice its size (low sheets, Nightreign).
Add a cell the size of the selected (or last) cell in the next free place of its grid, with the next number in its name.
No free slot of that size is left on the sheet's grid.
Remove the selected cells from the layout.
Cut each selected cell out of the sheet and save it as its name .png in the export folder ({0}).
Add a block of cells: columns x rows of one size, numbered from a start id. Also fills layouts made with Create Layout.
The top left corner of the first cell, in sheet pixels.
How many cells across and down. Cells are numbered row by row.
The size of each cell in sheet pixels.
Cells are named prefix + number + suffix, the number zero-padded to the digit count (MENU_ItemIcon_ + 00123 + .png). Numbers in use are skipped.
Leave out grid places that overlap an existing cell.
Take the size, position and name pattern from the selected (or last) cell, with the next free number as the start id.
Add the cells as one undoable step, formatted like the selected (or last) cell.
Problems in this layout. Cells with the same rectangle (aliases) and cells inside other cells are normal and not listed. Click a problem to select its cells.
Every cell of the layout. Click to select and show it in the viewport (Shift adds).
